baseline.holdoutRule: The v1-v10 holdouts were promoted to regression after evaluation. The v11 outer-package case was promoted after its first complete candidate evaluation in v12. That v12 evaluation was invalidated: its positive holdout and the v3 regression bottle were the same underlying CNA photograph (0.997937 similarity after the complete production image path), so the duplicate was removed instead of counted twice. Every complete run now fails before any model call when two declared sources reach 0.995 perceptual similarity. The two v13 holdouts are previously unused real-network visuals selected, pixel-reviewed, truth-labelled and frozen before either was submitted to the production or candidate profile: one video frame has a distinguishable Singapore Deposit Mark and linear product barcode on the same bottle; one retail photograph has the bottle label obscured by the user's hands. They are developer-visible, non-adaptive holdouts rather than an independently sealed or blinded evaluation set, and must not be used to revise and re-score the same candidate.
